about.altBaslik: The right address for AI-powered business analysis
about.s1Icerik: KurgemX is an AI-powered business analysis platform for business analysts and software teams. Developed by experts with over 25 years of industry experience in business analysis, project management, and software development.
about.s2Icerik: KurgemX automates story map, business analysis document, prototype, and test scenario generation using AI. With Turkish language support and TRY pricing, KurgemX is a pioneer in the Turkish market.
about.s3Icerik: To accelerate business analysis processes, improve quality, and enable software teams to work more efficiently.

salesAgreement.kanun: Pursuant to Turkish Consumer Protection Law No. 6502
salesAgreement.s2Icerik: This agreement governs the terms under which the buyer subscribes digitally to the KurgemX platform. The service is a digital SaaS (Software as a Service) offering that includes story mapping, business analysis document creation, prototyping, and test scenario generation features.
salesAgreement.s3Icerik:
Freemium: $0 — 1 small project per month, max 5 stories
Starter: $9/month — 3 projects per month, max 15 stories
Pro: $29/month — 10 projects per month, max 40 stories
Listed prices include applicable taxes. Prices are in USD; the exchange rate at the time of payment applies.
salesAgreement.s4Icerik: Paid subscriptions are charged in advance on a monthly billing cycle. Payment is collected automatically via the credit or debit card provided at registration. Subscriptions may be suspended in the event of payment failure.
salesAgreement.s5Icerik: Under Article 49 of Turkish Consumer Protection Law No. 6502, consumers have the right to withdraw within 14 days of a distance contract. However, where the buyer has requested and explicitly consented to the commencement of service performance before the withdrawal period expires, the right of withdrawal cannot be exercised. Since service performance begins at the moment of subscription activation, the buyer provides explicit consent to this during activation. Accordingly, the right of withdrawal does not apply to this digital content service.
salesAgreement.s6Icerik: The buyer may cancel their subscription at any time. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period; access to all features continues until that date. No refunds are issued for unused time. The Freemium plan is free of charge and therefore not subject to refund.
salesAgreement.s7Icerik: Turkish law governs any disputes arising from this agreement. Istanbul courts and enforcement offices have jurisdiction.

terms.giris: By using KurgemX, you agree to the following terms. Please read carefully.
terms.s1Icerik: KurgemX is a SaaS platform offering AI-powered business analysis and prototyping services on a subscription basis.
terms.s2Icerik: You are solely responsible for the security of your account and all actions performed through it. You must keep your password secure and immediately notify support@kurgemx.com of any unauthorized access.
terms.s3Icerik: The platform uses third-party AI services such as Anthropic's Claude model for content generation. Generated content is informational only and does not constitute professional advice. Evaluating the accuracy and suitability of this content is the user's responsibility.
terms.s4Icerik: KurgemX reserves the right to modify platform features, pricing, or terms of service with prior notice. Significant changes will be announced by email at least 30 days in advance.
terms.s5Icerik: These terms are governed by Turkish law. Istanbul courts have jurisdiction over any disputes.

privacy.giris: At KurgemX, we care about your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect and how we use it.
privacy.s1Icerik: We collect name, email address, and project content (stories, acceptance criteria, analysis texts). This data is used solely to provide the service.
privacy.s2Icerik: Your data is stored securely on Supabase infrastructure. Supabase applies industry-standard encryption and security measures.
privacy.s3Icerik: Project data is sent to the Anthropic API for content generation. Anthropic does not use this data for model training. Your data is not shared with advertisers or other third parties.
privacy.s4Icerik: The platform operates in accordance with Turkey's Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK, Law No. 6698). Explicit consent for data processing is obtained during registration.
privacy.s5Icerik: To delete your account and all associated data, send a request to support@kurgemx.com. Requests are processed within 30 business days.

refund.giris: The refund and cancellation policy applicable to KurgemX subscriptions is described below.
refund.s1Icerik: When you cancel your subscription, you retain full access to all features until the end of the current billing period. Access is not immediately revoked upon cancellation.
refund.s2Icerik: As long as you cancel before the next billing period begins, no charge will be made for the new period.
refund.s3Icerik: No refunds are issued for unused time remaining in the current period. Subscription fees are charged in advance at the beginning of each period.
refund.s4Icerik: The refund policy does not apply to the free Freemium plan.
